description: This file implements the logic for deleting a favorite article in the application. It includes the command definition, validation, and the handler that processes the delete operation, interacts with the database context, and returns the updated article data.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a favorite article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the command's Slug property is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles processing the delete favorite request, performing database lookups and modifications, and returning the updated article envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the delete favorite logic: finds the article and user, removes the favorite if exists, and returns the updated article data.
